title: Conductive material dispersion and lithium secondary battery manufactured using the same
abstract: The invention provides a conductive material dispersion liquid, which comprises a conductive material, a dispersing agent and a dispersion medium, wherein the conductive material comprises bundled carbon nanotubes, and the volume density of the bundled carbon nanotubes is 10-50 kg/m 3 And the conductivity satisfies the condition of the following equation 1, thereby exhibiting excellent dispersibility and conductivity; the present invention also provides a lithium secondary battery manufactured using the conductive material dispersion, thereby being capable of exhibiting excellent battery functions, particularly excellent output characteristics at low temperatures: [ equation 1]-X.ltoreq.10 logR.ltoreq.0.6X (in the above equation 1, X is the bulk density of the carbon nanotube, and R is the powder resistance of the carbon nanotube under a pressure of 10 to 65 MPa).
